{{Otheruses|Virginia}}
{{Quote|He exists! Yes, Virginia Landrunner, there is a Meatlump King. And he's nestled smugly in his hideaway underneath Coronet.|Vani Korr, in ''Who are the Meatlumps?''|<ref name="SWG:acoVKsMa">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|a copy of Vani Korr's second Meatlump article}}</ref>}}
'''Virginia Landrunner''' was an individual who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Landrunner was an acquaintance of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Vani Korr]] of the ''[[Corellia Times]]'' newspaper.<ref name="SWG:MtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Meet the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Vani Korr mentioned Virginia Landrunner in ''[[Who are the Meatlumps?]]'': an investigation article about the [[Meatlumps]], a group of fanatical anti-technology criminals and terrorists.<ref name="SWG:MtM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Virginia Landrunner was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MtM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Virginia Landrunner was mentioned in the second part of Vani Korr's article ''Who are the Meatlumps?'', introduced in the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
